tree.content: The user is asking whether the documentation adequately addresses that intentd changes also require waiting, since they ship through a two-stage proce…

blocks.content: Partially. The current text does say the obligation applies "when the work changed intentd **and/or** cloudlands-fe" and that you wait "until the work ships in a **cloudlands-fe** alpha" — so intentd changes are covered by implication. But it doesn't spell out the flow: an intentd change first cuts an intentd release, gets pinned into cloudlands-fe automatically, and only then rides the next cloudlands-fe alpha (roughly an hour later). I'll have the implementor make that explicit with one brief sentence.
